GW has more restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus than Howard, Georgetown and American combined.

Every DC university with 10,000+ students:

1. GW: 280
2. Howard: 77
3. Georgetown: 52
4. American: 13

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/campus/dc
